title: Route simple work to the local small model
narrative: Fangore has mixed work to route. For a simple request he asks a small decision model which lane fits, product policy accepts the local small-model lane, and he verifies the chosen route is local — not frontier or human. Related: `fangore_decision_plane_model_policy`, `nubble_insp_model_routing`.[^jev-us07]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` runtime (`run_decision_plane_policy`) answers a bounded route choice with envelopes. Host quality policy may override a cheap route when complexity facts demand frontier or human. Invalid routes and low confidence escalate; model signals never invent new lanes.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/simple_local.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
